BiblicalUsage: Shua is a cry, a halloo for help, and it appears where men cry out in their extremity. Job says a man will not stretch out his hand to the grave though they cry in his destruction, and he asks whether God will esteem a man's cry when distress comes. The word is the sound of a person calling for rescue.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a cry for help is a prayer even when it has no words for God in it, and God hears the cry even when He does not answer on our timetable.
